notes: Wrapped from existing Prismata repository artifact.
Preserves source metadata for future unwrap support.

content.text:
﻿items:
  - udi: prismata.items.main.start
    key: main.start
    name: Start Prismata
    label: Start Prismata
    type: action
    order: 1
    selectionMethod: number
    action: execute
    ui_framework: menu
    capability: prismata.app.start
    navigateTarget: null
    submenu_ref: null
    executeTarget: start_prismata
    icon: "▶"
    colourScheme: default
    description: Launch the main application flow.
    visibilityMode: static
    visibilityCondition: null
    visibilityDependencies:
      - app_ready
    enableMode: enabled
    enableCondition: null
    registryKey: item.start
    registryOverrides:
      defaultColourScheme: start-item
    style:
      emphasis: strong
    borderScheme: default
    metadata:
      origin: exemplar

  - udi: prismata.items.main.settings
    key: main.settings
    name: Settings
    label: Settings
    type: navigate
    order: 2
    selectionMethod: number
    action: navigate
    ui_framework: menu
    capability: prismata.menu.settings
    navigateTarget: menu.settings
    submenu_ref: menu.settings
    executeTarget: null
    icon: "⚙️"
    colourScheme: default
    description: Open the settings menu.
    visibilityMode: conditional
    visibilityCondition: project_selected == true
    visibilityDependencies:
      - project_selected
    enableMode: conditional
    enableCondition: config_exists('config/project-menus/settings.yaml') == true
    registryKey: item.settings
    registryOverrides:
      defaultColourScheme: nav-item
    style:
      emphasis: normal
    borderScheme: default
    metadata:
      shortcut: F2

  - udi: prismata.items.main.quit
    key: main.quit
    name: Quit
    label: Quit
    type: static
    order: 3
    selectionMethod: none
    action: exit
    ui_framework: basic
    capability: prismata.app.quit
    navigateTarget: null
    submenu_ref: null
    executeTarget: null
    icon: "🚪"
    colourScheme: default
    description: Exit the application.
    visibilityMode: hidden
    visibilityCondition: null
    visibilityDependencies:
      - user_requested_quit
    enableMode: disabled
    enableCondition: null
    registryKey: item.quit
    registryOverrides:
      defaultColourScheme: quit-item
    style:
      emphasis: muted
    borderScheme: default
    metadata:
      exitCode: 0

  - udi: prismata.items.settings.darkmode
    key: settings.darkmode
    name: Dark Mode
    label: Dark Mode
    type: toggle
    order: 4
    selectionMethod: toggle
    action: execute
    ui_framework: toggle_table
    capability: prismata.settings.toggle_dark_mode
    executeTarget: toggle_darkmode
    icon: "☾"
    colourScheme: default
    description: Toggle dark mode.
    visibilityMode: conditional
    visibilityCondition: feature_flag('dark_mode') == true
    visibilityDependencies:
      - dark_mode
    enableMode: conditional
    enableCondition: env('ENABLE_DARK_MODE') == true
    registryKey: item.darkmode
    registryOverrides:
      defaultColourScheme: toggle-item
    style:
      emphasis: strong
    borderScheme: default
    metadata:
      setting: appearance

  - udi: prismata.items.settings.volume
    key: settings.volume
    name: Volume
    label: Volume
    type: slider
    order: 5
    selectionMethod: slider
    action: execute
    ui_framework: custom
    capability: prismata.settings.adjust_volume
    executeTarget: adjust_volume
    icon: "🔊"
    colourScheme: default
    description: Adjust the audio volume.
    visibilityMode: conditional
    visibilityCondition: config_exists('audio.yaml') == true
    visibilityDependencies:
      - audio_config
    enableMode: conditional
    enableCondition: project_has_tag('audio') == true
    registryKey: item.volume
    registryOverrides:
      defaultColourScheme: slider-item
    style:
      emphasis: strong
    borderScheme: default
    metadata:
      unit: percent

  - udi: prismata.items.settings.theme
    key: settings.theme
    name: Theme
    label: Theme
    type: carousel
    order: 6
    selectionMethod: carousel
    action: execute
    ui_framework: custom
    capability: prismata.settings.cycle_theme
    executeTarget: cycle_theme
    icon: "🎨"
    colourScheme: default
    description: Cycle between available themes.
    visibilityMode: static
    visibilityCondition: null
    visibilityDependencies:
      - themes_available
    enableMode: enabled
    enableCondition: null
    registryKey: item.theme
    registryOverrides:
      defaultColourScheme: carousel-item
    style:
      emphasis: normal
    borderScheme: default
    metadata:
      presetCount: 4

  - udi: prismata.items.admin.logs
    key: admin.logs
    name: View Logs
    label: View Logs
    type: header
    order: 7
    selectionMethod: none
    action: none
    ui_framework: basic
    capability: prismata.admin.view_logs
    executeTarget: null
    icon: "📄"
    colourScheme: default
    description: Non-interactive section heading.
    visibilityMode: hidden
    visibilityCondition: user_is_admin == true
    visibilityDependencies:
      - user_is_admin
    enableMode: disabled
    enableCondition: null
    registryKey: item.admin.logs
    registryOverrides:
      defaultColourScheme: header-item
    style:
      emphasis: section
    borderScheme: default
    metadata:
      section: admin

  - udi: prismata.items.admin.users
    key: admin.users
    name: Manage Users
    label: Manage Users
    type: menu
    order: 8
    selectionMethod: number
    action: navigate
    ui_framework: menu
    capability: prismata.admin.manage_users
    navigateTarget: menu.admin.users
    submenu_ref: menu.admin.users
    executeTarget: null
    icon: "👥"
    colourScheme: default
    description: Navigate to the user management menu.
    visibilityMode: conditional
    visibilityCondition: user_is_admin == true
    visibilityDependencies:
      - user_is_admin
    enableMode: conditional
    enableCondition: feature_flag('user_admin') == true
    registryKey: item.admin.users
    registryOverrides:
      defaultColourScheme: admin-item
    style:
      emphasis: strong
    borderScheme: default
    metadata:
      route: admin/users
